title: The Part Library page keeps upper and lower case in a typed part number
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBCASE-01) is active at {Location-A}.
  • {Number-A} is a new number written in mixed upper and lower case (for example ZZautotest-PL-LibCase-01m) that no entry uses.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the {Part-A} row.
  4. Click the edit icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  5. Replace the Part Number with {Number-A}, typing its capitals and small letters exactly.
  6. Click Save.
  7. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  8. Type {Number-A} in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: The field shows the letters exactly as typed: they are not turned into capitals.
  • Step 6: The change is saved and the detail page's "Part number" reads {Number-A} exactly as typed (for example ZZautotest-PL-LibCase-01m, not ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBCASE-01M).
  • Step 8: The Inventory list shows the part number with the same mix of capitals and small letters.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S11-R3b, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy.
